thread:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: enabling catalog entry "orion-quant-v2" in eu-west1 at 2026-05-10T20:00:00Z. Change window 1h. Release notes: https://rwdx/repo/releases/orion-quant-v2 :rocket:

ravi: Quick ask — please pin canary to 8% and set fallback order to [orion-quant-v2, orion-quant-v1, llama-2-lite]. We want deterministic fallback for latency-sensitive routes.

lina: Ack. Will add pin and fallback. I'm on call 20:00-22:00 UTC though, prefer not to start earlier than 21:30.

natalie: Noted. There's a scheduled infra patch at 21:45 in eu-west1; SRE advised holding tills patches finish. @sre-oncall can you confirm?

sre-oncall: confirmed — patch may cause transient pod restarts until ~21:55. Recommend start at 22:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

alex: Re: metrics — add canary alerts: 5xx spike >3% for 5m or latency p95 increase >200ms. If triggered, auto-rollback to orion-quant-v1.

lina: Pushing config:
```
model_catalog.enable: orion-quant-v2
canary.percent: 8
fallback.order: ["orion-quant-v2","orion-quant-v1","llama-2-lite"]
pin.ttl: 72h
```

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled at 2026-05-10T22:00:00Z by lina. Change window 60m. Preflight checks passed.

deploy-bot: STARTED canary rollout - 8% traffic -> orion-quant-v2 (eu-west1). Rolling across 4 AZs.

ravi: :eyes: watching latency and 5xx dashboards.

deploy-bot: Observability note — p95 increased 40ms in first 2m, within guardrail.

deploy-bot: ALERT - 5xx rate spike to 4.2% over 3m in region eu-west1. Trigger rule: canary.rolling.5xx

natalie: saw it. Lina, recommend immediate rollback and pin to v1.

lina: running rollback now:
```
# rollback to pinned stable
rwdctl catalog update --disable orion-quant-v2 --pin orion-quant-v1 --reason "canary 5xx spike"
```

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK executed. orion-quant-v1 pinned. Canary disabled. Notifying incident channel.

sre-oncall: Confirmed errors subsiding. All systems normalizing.

ravi: Logging postmortem note: need to add a qlog to capture batch size distribution; I'll open an issue.

lina: filing follow-up: tweak fallback to put llama-2-lite after v1 for more predictable degradation.

deploy-bot: Closed change window early at 2026-05-10T22:12:15Z — rollback successful. :white_check_mark:

ravi: Thanks team. We'll re-evaluate thresholds and test under similar load before next enablement.
